docs.diagram.update-system.n.MODAL.desc: Lists each update with versions and changelog, the sources that could not be reached, and every direct link for a manual re-download. Library cards get an update badge. Nothing is applied until you pick it.
docs.diagram.update-system.n.REPO_SYNC.d: Opens the repo sync form with the URL and the chosen mods pre-filled. The sync refuses a manifest whose signature is invalid, missing where pinned, or mismatched before writing anything, and downloads only files whose SHA-256 differs.
docs.diagram.update-system.n.DIRECT_APPL: Downloads the file again (4 GB cap) and writes it over the mod's folder: a zip is extracted with size limits and no path escaping the folder, anything else is saved as one file. Only a link configured on that mod is accepted.
docs.diagram.update-system.n.DONE.desc: A direct update saves the new validator as the baseline and resets the mod's content id and file cache; a sync records the new version. The library refreshes and a re-check clears the badge.
docs.diagram.kind.ui.desc: Something you see and use: a page, a dialog, a card, a button.
docs.diagram.kind.front.desc: TypeScript in the window that has no UI of its own: a queue, a store, a router.
docs.diagram.kind.rust.desc: A Tauri command, worker or backend function: where files, network and processes are touched.
docs.diagram.kind.data.desc: A file, folder, database or cache that outlives the session.
docs.diagram.kind.ext.desc: The game, a server, the operating system, Discord, a model: things BMM talks to but does not own.
docs.diagram.kind.decision.desc: A branch the code takes. The edges leaving it say which way and why.
docs.diagram.kind.outcome.desc: Where a flow begins or ends: a state you can observe.
docs.diagram.ui.search: Find a step, a file or a function
docs.diagram.ui.renderError: This diagram could not be drawn.
docs.diagram.ui.copyFailed: Could not copy to the clipboard
docs.diagram.ui.hint: Click a step to see what it does and where it lives in the code.
docs.diagram.ui.keys: Keyboard: arrows move between steps, Enter opens a linked diagram, / finds, + and - zoom, 0 fits, Esc clears.
docs.diagram.ui.gallerySub: How BMM works, step by step. Each step names the code that does it.
iconpack.mineEmpty: Nothing here yet. Uploaded icons stay in this tab.
navedit.hlOff: Syntax colours are off above ~100 KB.
navedit.pagefilesHint: Use a relative path: src="assets/logo.png". Folders are kept as they are.
tutc.pickHint: Ctrl+click the element to pick it. A normal click navigates.
tutc.wait.exprHelp: count / text / value / exists / visible / enabled, with and · or · not · contains. e.g. visible('#modal-x') and count('.row') > 2
tuthub.fork: Make a copy I can edit
tutcat.b.title: Build a tutorial catalogue
tutcat.b.name: Catalogue name

dlg.title: A link wants to change something in BMM
dlg.name: Which is
dlg.origin.external: A web page or another program. The browser does not say which page.
dlg.origin.theme: A button in the active theme
dlg.origin.unknown: Unknown. Treat it like a web page.
dlg.origin.api: A program using BMM's local API
dlg.why.invalid: the value contains characters a path or address cannot have.
dlg.why.network: it names a network location. A link can never make BMM read or write on another machine.
dlg.why.relative: the path is not a full local path (like C:\folder).
dlg.why.traversal: the path climbs out of its folder with "..".
dlg.why.not-https: downloads from a link must use https.
dlg.why.bad-scheme: the address must start with http:// or https://.
dlg.why.credentials: the address carries a user name or password.
dlg.why.exe-param: a link cannot name a program to run. It can only start an app BMM already registered, by its id.
dlg.why.script: a link cannot install or run a script (.ps1, .bat, .cmd and the like).
dlg.why.no-checksum: an app installed from a link must carry a sha256 checksum, and it must match.
dlg.why.bad-checksum: the checksum in the link is not a sha256.
dlg.why.bad-id: the app id can only use letters, digits, dot, dash and underscore.
dlg.why.unknown-action: BMM does not know that link's action, so nothing here decided what it is allowed to do.
dlg.why.key-from-link: a link cannot choose or unlock a signing key. Keys are bound in Settings > Identity & API only.

dlg.do.appInstall: Download this file and install it as an app. An installer (.exe, .msi) will RUN on this computer.

dlg.do.replayExport: Save your recorded session to a file you choose.

dlg.do.pluginDelete: Uninstall this plugin: its files, its registration and its permissions.
dlg.do.pluginActivate: Apply this plugin (its mod list, scripts or automations, depending on the plugin).
dlg.do.publishSsh: Upload a folder to your saved SSH server. You pick the folder next.
dlg.do.catalogPublish: Write a catalogue into a folder. You pick the folder next.
dlg.do.follow: Follow this catalogue. BMM will fetch it at every start.
dlg.do.repoConnect: Connect this mod repo, with the password the link carries, if any.
dlg.do.langInline: Install the translation carried in this link.

dlg.do.modDisable: Disable this mod in the active profile.

dlg.do.modpackDisable: Disable every mod of this modpack.
dlg.do.modpackCreate: Create a modpack with this name.
dlg.do.catalogEntry: Change an entry of a catalogue you author on this computer.
dlg.note.checksum: The file is checked against the sha256 in the link and refused if it does not match.
dlg.note.unverified: The link carries no checksum, so the file's integrity cannot be checked.
dlg.note.pluginDisabled: the plugin is installed disabled, with no permissions.
dlg.note.picker: You choose the folder next. Nothing is written until you do.
dlg.note.saveDialog: You choose where the file goes next.
dlg.note.redacted: Tokens, keys and passwords are removed from the copy. For a full backup, use Settings > Data.
dlg.note.fullDropped: Unmasked recording cannot be turned on from a link; that part was ignored. Use Settings > Privacy.
dlg.note.rpcPublic: Discord will show your profile name and your Creator ID to anyone who can see your status.
dlg.note.fetchedOnStart: The address is contacted every time BMM starts, until you stop following it.
dlg.note.plainHttp: This address uses plain http: what it sends can be read or changed on the way.
api.epAbout.schedRuns: The last 50 runs of one scheduled task, newest first: each step with its duration, its status and, when it failed, why. Secrets are removed before a run is written. Needs schedules.read.
api.epAbout.resources: The stored preset, the one in force right now (app mode or a task may differ), the task-scoped preset and its time left, app mode, and the queue of heavy operations. Needs resources.read.
api.epAbout.resHardware: CPU cores and instruction sets, GPUs (listed only, BMM runs no compute on them) and each disk’s bus and seek penalty. The first call can take up to 3 seconds. Needs resources.read.
api.epAbout.resPreset: A NAMED preset: silent, balanced, max or custom. persistent (default) is stored; task ends by itself after ttlSecs (2 h at most). Never overrides app mode. Needs resources.write.
api.epAbout.resGame: auto lets detection decide, on and off force it. While an app runs, BMM’s heavy work is throttled. Needs resources.write.
api.epAbout.resQueue: pause_all, resume_all, or pause / resume / cancel one operation by its id (from the status). Cancelling throws work away, so it also needs mods.write. Needs resources.write.
api.epF.resQueueId: The operation’s id, for pause, resume and cancel
api.epAbout.resIoRule: One per-disk, per-operation rule: rate_mb_s, parallel, buffer_kib, io_priority. Values are clamped to the hard bounds; rule: null removes it. The admin token only: a plugin is refused even with resources.write.
api.epF.resRuleOp: * or deploy, install, backup, extract, compress, scan, hash, download, image, maintenance
api.epF.resRuleRule: { rate_mb_s?, parallel?, buffer_kib?, io_priority? } (null removes the rule)
api.card.schedRunsDesc: The last 50 runs of one task, each step with its duration and, when it failed, why.
api.card.resStatusDesc: The preset in force, app mode and the queue of heavy operations.
api.card.resHardwareDesc: CPU features, GPUs and each disk’s bus.
api.card.resPresetDesc: silent, balanced, max or custom. A task-scoped one ends by itself.
api.card.resGameDesc: auto lets detection decide; on and off force it.
api.card.resQueueDesc: Every operation, or one by its id. Cancelling also needs mods.write.
api.dl.runsId: The task’s id, as the scheduler shows it
api.dl.runsAbout: Opens the same log as the task’s History button. Read-only, so it asks nothing.
api.dl.resOpenAbout: Shows the Storage manager, with the live resources dashboard. Navigation only.
api.dl.resPresetAbout: A named preset only; no per-disk rule can be set by a link. From a web page or another program it asks first, and only once every 10 seconds.
resources.link.presetDo: Switch BMM’s resource preset. It stays until you change it in Settings > Storage.
dlg.why.bad-preset: a link can only name one of the presets: silent, balanced, max, custom.
dlg.why.burst: another link asked to change the preset less than 10 seconds ago.

sched.allowNet: This task may send webhooks and Discord or Slack messages, and read feeds. Never a private address unless a step allows the local network.

sched.act.feed.publish: Add an entry to a feed (RSS/Atom)

sched.actd.discord.send: Post a message to a Discord channel through its webhook address.
sched.actd.slack.send: Post a message to a Slack channel through an incoming webhook.
sched.actd.feed.publish: Add an entry to an Atom feed file this task keeps: any RSS reader can follow it.
sched.wh.urlHint: http(s) only. A private address (this PC, your network) is refused unless the box below is ticked.
sched.wh.bodyHint: {variables} are filled in before sending. In JSON they are escaped, so a quote or a line break in a value cannot break the document.
sched.wh.secretHint: Sent like the others, but never shown in a log, an error, the debugger or a step summary. Put tokens here.
sched.wh.adv: Advanced: retries, timeout, keep the answer
sched.wh.retries: Extra attempts on a network error, 429 or 5xx (0–4)
sched.wh.into: Keep the answer in a variable
sched.wh.badJson: The body is not valid JSON: {e}
sched.wh.noMessage: There is no message to send.
sched.net.permHint: Needs the “Network” permission of the task.
sched.chat.discordHint: Server settings → Integrations → Webhooks → Copy URL. The address IS the password: it is never shown in logs.
sched.chat.slackHint: An incoming webhook of your Slack app (hooks.slack.com/services/…). Never shown in logs.
sched.feed.title: Title
sched.feed.path: File (relative = in the task’s output folder)
sched.feed.hint: An Atom file, newest first. Point any RSS reader at it, or host the folder with Server Repo.
sched.feed.notFeed: That address did not answer with an RSS or Atom feed.
task.feed.notOurs: That file exists and is not a feed BMM keeps: it was left alone.
task.feed.badPath: A feed file cannot be written there ({s}).
sched.net.dns: That host name could not be found.
sched.net.connect: Could not connect to the server.
sched.net.badHeader: The header “{s}” has an unusable name or value.
sched.net.method: Only POST, PUT and PATCH can be sent.
sched.net.redirect: The server redirected somewhere that cannot be followed.
sched.net.tooLarge: The answer is larger than allowed.
sched.net.why.private: a private address (allow the local network in the step to reach it)
sched.v.json: Not valid JSON (with every {variable} replaced by text).
sched.v.regexNested: Nested repetition like (a+)+ can take minutes on a long text; BMM stops it after a moment. Simplify it if you can.
sched.regex.timeout: The pattern took too long and was stopped (it may backtrack catastrophically). Simplify it.
sched.trRss: When a feed has a new item
sched.trRssNone: When a feed has a new item (no address)
sched.trRssHint: The first check only learns what is there. After that, each new item runs the task once, with {event.title}, {event.link}, {event.id}, {event.published} and {event.count}.

sched.why.rssIdle: Watching {v}: no new item since the last check.
sched.why.rssArming: Watching {v}: the first check will learn what is there.

sched.test.stopped: It stopped the task (a guard clause)
sched.test.confirm: Testing “{s}” runs it for real: whatever it changes is changed. Continue?

sched.insp.debugHint: Start Debug in the header: while the run is paused, this shows the values this step reads or writes.
sched.bp.gutter: Click beside a line to pause there when debugging
sched.bp.noStep: No step there to put a breakpoint on.
sched.dbg.jumpTip: Show this step in the editor

sched.vp.title: Variables

sched.modes.codeDesc: The task as text, with completion and a reference: fastest when you know what you want.

ai.settings.title: AI (optional)
ai.settings.unavailable: The AI settings could not be read.
ai.settings.lead: Optional help with mod metadata and reports. Suggestions always come from the mod’s own files first; a provider is only asked if you turn this on and choose one, and nothing is written until you tick it and click Apply.
ai.settings.notBundled: Laya is a multilingual classifier: it picks tags from YOUR list and detects the language, it does not write text. It can run built into BMM, offline, or on a server you choose. Descriptions come from the mod’s files, or from an external API you configure yourself.
ai.settings.killedNote: AI is switched off for this session by --no-ai or the BMM_NO_AI environment variable.
ai.settings.installerOn: The installer turned this on with Laya offline: suggestions are computed on this PC and nothing is sent.
ai.settings.installerOff: The installer left the optional AI features off.
ai.settings.masterHint: Off: no AI network request at all, anywhere in BMM. The file-based suggestions keep working.
ai.settings.bcWhat: Sent to bettercommunity.ch with your account when you ask for a suggestion: the mod’s name, author, description, excerpts of its readme/manifest and up to 40 file names (personal paths masked), plus the names of your tags. For a report hint: the report text, already masked. Nothing is sent in the background.
ai.settings.bcConsent: I accept that this text is sent to BetterCommunity when I ask for a suggestion or a hint.
ai.settings.localWhat: Install Laya yourself (pip install "laya[serve]", then laya-serve with LAYA_MODELS=multilingual) and BMM will call it at POST /v1/systemone. Nothing leaves this PC as long as the address is local.
ai.settings.localRemote: Allow a server on another machine (the text then leaves this PC)
ai.settings.remoteWarn: This server is not on this PC: the mod text will be sent over the network to it.
ai.settings.externalWhat: Only used when you tick “ask for a description draft” in the suggestion dialog. The mod’s facts (as above) are sent to the address you enter, with your key; that service’s own terms apply.
ai.settings.sent1: Only when you click Suggest, ask for a draft, or ask for a report hint. Never in the background.
ai.settings.sent2: Mod: name, author, description, readme/manifest excerpts, up to 40 file names, your tag names. User names in paths, e-mails and IPs are masked first.
ai.settings.sent3: Report hint: the report text after masking. The report itself is sent only by the Send button.
ai.settings.sent4: Never: your files’ contents, your keys, anything while this switch is off.
ai.suggest.tip: Proposes a name, version, author, description, tags and links from the mod’s files. Nothing is written until you choose.
ai.suggest.title: Suggestions for {name}
ai.suggest.lead: Tick what you want to keep. Nothing is written until you click Apply.
ai.suggest.draft: Also ask the external API for a description draft
ai.suggest.appliedSkipped: Applied. A mod holds at most 3 tags: the extra ones were not added.
ai.settings.sent0: With Laya built in, nothing is sent: the text is read on this PC only.
ai.emb.title: Laya built in (offline)
ai.emb.what: Laya runs inside BMM, on this PC: no server, no account and no network while it works, so nothing you ask it about leaves this PC. It only answers when you click Suggest or ask for a report hint.
ai.emb.fromInstaller: Installed with BMM; the uninstaller removes it.
ai.emb.loaded: Loaded in memory. Released after 5 minutes unused.
ai.emb.installHint: A single download from {host}, checked against its pinned SHA-256, resumed if interrupted. Afterwards Laya works without a connection. Nothing about you is sent.
ai.emb.resume: {got} already downloaded: the download resumes from there.
ai.emb.done: Laya is installed and is now the classifier. Turn the AI switch on to use it.
ai.emb.removeConfirm: Remove the downloaded Laya model? Suggestions from Laya stop until you install it again.
ai.emb.pending: Part of the model is still in use; it is removed at the next start.
ai.emb.offline: Nothing was sent: Laya ran on this PC.
ai.ask.title: Ask Laya
ai.ask.lead: Ask about BMM or your mods. Answers come from the docs, your settings and your mods' files.
ai.ask.placeholder: e.g. which mod modifies engine.ogg? What is app mode? Which mods conflict?
ai.ask.none: Nothing in BMM's documentation or in your library answers this question.
ai.ask.conflicts: Mods that provide the same files
ai.ask.low: Laya thinks none of these answers the question exactly: check the quoted text before relying on it.
ai.ask.offline: Offline: the question never leaves this PC.
ai.ask.offAi: Keyword search only: turn the AI switch on (Settings, AI) to let Laya rank the answers.
ai.ask.offModel: Keyword search only: Laya is not installed.
ai.ask.offFeature: Keyword search only: Laya ranking is turned off for Ask in Settings.
ai.ask.smartOn: Smart search on: descriptions and tags count too, ranked by Laya when AI is on. A question + Enter opens Ask Laya. Click to turn off.
ai.ask.smartOff: Smart search off: click to also search descriptions and tags, ranked by Laya when AI is on. A question + Enter opens Ask Laya.
ai.emb.outdatedHint: An older model pack is installed. The update is a {size} download, checked against its pinned SHA-256.
ai.emb.noSpace: Not enough disk space: the install needs {need}, the disk has {free} free. Free some space, then check again.
ai.emb.testOk: Laya works: sample classified as « {tag} » ({tagP} %), language {lang}, in {ms} ms (loading: {load} ms).
ai.emb.testOdd: Laya answered, but not as expected: « {tag} » ({tagP} %), language {lang}, in {ms} ms. Remove and reinstall the model if this persists.
ai.first.absent: Laya is not installed: suggestions come from the mod's files only.
ai.settings.fAsk: « Ask Laya » and the library's smart search: let Laya route and rank (the search itself always works, offline)
ai.reason.embNoSpace: not enough disk space for the model
ai.reason.embAbsent: The built-in Laya model is not installed (Settings → AI).
ai.reason.embCorrupt: A file of the built-in model does not match its checksum: remove the model and install it again.
ai.reason.embNotPublished: The model download is not available yet.
ai.reason.embHash: The download did not match its pinned checksum and was discarded.
ai.reason.embIncomplete: The download stopped before the end: click Install again to resume it.
ai.reason.embRuntime: ONNX Runtime could not be loaded from the model folder.
ai.reason.embInUse: The model is in use: try again in a moment.
ai.reason.embTooLong: This question is too long for the model.

stm.game.schedHint: A task that falls due while the app runs waits until app mode ends. A task you run by hand still runs.
stm.presets.title: Presets for this PC

stm.presets.notHere: Nothing to act on on this PC
stm.presets.notHereLong: This PC has no drive this preset is for, so it would change nothing.
stm.presets.nothing: Everything this preset sets is already in force.
stm.presets.capsKept: Speed caps kept as they are: {d}.

stm.presets.why.default: Nothing on this PC calls for more than the defaults.

ai.set2.masterHint: Off: no AI request, anywhere. Suggestions from the mod's files still work.
ai.set2.stOnline: some text may leave this PC

ai.set2.clsBcHint: Laya on bettercommunity.ch, with your account. Text is sent when you ask.
ai.set2.clsOffHint: Suggestions come from the mod's files only.

ai.set2.fModHint: Laya ranks tags from your list.
ai.set2.fAskHint: Laya ranks the results. Search works without it.
ai.set2.fDraftHint: Written by the Writing model, checked by Laya.
ai.set2.fAskGenHint: An answer from the sources found, each one cited.
ai.set2.aboutLaya: Laya is a classifier: it picks among options it is given (your tags, a report category, which source answers) and says none when nothing fits. The Writing model only words drafts and answers from facts it is handed; what it writes is checked (no link, file or command that the sources do not contain) and shown as a suggestion.
ai.set2.sentGen: Writing: with a local model, nothing leaves this PC. With a remote API, the mod facts (or your question and the sources found) go to it, only when you click Draft or Write.
ai.reason.genInjection: the text looked like an instruction, not a description. Discarded.
ai.reason.genInvented: it named a link or a file the sources do not contain. Discarded.
ai.reason.genNoCitation: the answer cited no source. Discarded.
ai.reason.genTagsOutside: tags outside your list were ignored.
ai.reason.layaRejected: Laya found it not supported by the facts. Discarded.
ai.reason.layaUnchecked: not checked by Laya (Laya is off).
ai.reason.layaAbstain: Laya found no source that answers. Nothing written.
ai.reason.nothingFound: nothing was found to answer from.
ai.sug2.draftNote: Draft: written by a model from the mod's files. Read it before applying.

laya.fb.title: Laya
laya.fb.subAuto: Proposals while you write. Nothing changes until you apply one.

laya.cstep.mod_archive: Check the files of the mod or download it again, then reinstall it.
laya.cstep.mod_conflict: Open the load order and resolve the conflicts, or disable the last mod you added.
laya.cstep.mod_deploy: Undeploy, then deploy again. If links fail, run BMM as administrator or turn on Windows Developer Mode.
laya.cstep.game_launch: Check the game path in the profile and that the game starts without mods.
laya.cstep.game_files: Verify the game files in its launcher, then rescan the profile.
laya.cstep.disk_full: Free space on the game's drive and on the drive that holds BMM's data.
laya.cstep.permission: Close the game and the programs that use these files, check your antivirus, or run BMM as administrator.
laya.cstep.file_missing: Check that the drive is connected and the folder still exists, then fix the path in the profile.
laya.cstep.network_offline: Check the internet connection, the proxy or the firewall, then try again.
laya.cstep.network_server: The server may be down: try again later, or check the repository or catalog address.
laya.cstep.ui_script: Reload the window with Ctrl+R. If it comes back, send this report with the session.
laya.cstep.webview: Update the graphics driver and the Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime, then restart BMM.
laya.cstep.internal_error: This is a bug in BMM: send this report so it can be fixed.
laya.cstep.background_task: Open the Scheduler and the plugins, and disable the last task or plugin you added.
laya.cstep.data_corrupt: Restore a backup of BMM's data, or import the profile again.
laya.cstep.ai_engine: Reload Laya's model in Settings, Manage Laya, or turn the AI off and on again.
laya.cstep.update_failed: Download the latest version from the website and install it over this one.
laya.cstep.out_of_memory: Close other programs, then try again with fewer mods or a smaller archive.
laya.cstep.other: Open the report and send it with a few words on what you were doing.

prof.newLead: A profile ties one game folder to one mods folder. Enabling a mod copies it into the game; disabling puts the game back.
prof.stepFoldersLead: The game folder receives the mods you enable. The mods folder is where they are kept, unpacked or as archives.
prof.chk.missing: This folder does not exist (any more). Pick another one.
prof.chk.sharedGame: Also the game folder of: {profiles}. That works: the files a mod puts in the game belong to the game folder, not to a profile. A file another profile deployed is never backed up as an original, and disabling falls back to the other profile's copy.
prof.chk.gameInMods: The game folder is inside the mods folder: enabling a mod would copy it into its own source.
prof.chk.modsIsGame: The mods folder cannot be the game folder itself.
prof.chk.modsInGame: This mods folder is inside the game folder. It works, but a game update or repair may touch it.
prof.chk.sharedMods: Already the mods folder of: {profiles}. Both profiles will list the same mods.
prof.chk.backupIsOther: The backup folder must be a folder of its own, not the game or mods folder.
prof.chk.backupInGame: This backup folder is inside the game folder: a game update may delete the originals kept there.
prof.chk.sharedBackup: Already the backup folder of: {profiles}. Each profile needs its own, or disabling a mod could restore another profile's files.
prof.suggest.none: No mods folder next to the game yet: pick or create one with Browse.
